symptoms.question: Does the air conditioning fail to blow cold air? (yes/no)
Do you notice a musty smell when using the AC? (yes/no)
Is the cabin fan airflow weak even at high fan settings? (yes/no)
Do the windows fog up more than usual? (yes/no)

rules.diagnosis: AC not cooling can be caused by low refrigerant or AC system fault.
rules.advice: Book an AC service to check refrigerant level and leaks.

rules.diagnosis: Musty smell from AC can indicate mould in the system or a dirty cabin filter.
rules.advice: Replace the cabin filter and consider an AC cleaning treatment.

rules.diagnosis: Weak airflow can be caused by a blocked cabin filter or blower fan issue.
rules.advice: Check or replace the cabin filter. If airflow remains weak, have the blower checked.

rules.diagnosis: Excessive window fogging can be related to humidity, cabin filter issues, or heater/AC performance.
rules.advice: Use AC/defrost mode. If fogging is persistent, have cabin filter and climate system checked.
